title: Clauses for a gate
statement:
For a gate type and a list of child circuits on $n$ variables, the gate clauses are defined as follows. For an AND gate with output variable $g$ and child variables $c_1,\ldots,c_k$, they comprise $(g\lor
eg c_1\lor\cdots\lor
eg c_k)$ and, for each child $c_i$, the clause $(
eg g\lor c_i)$. For an OR gate, they comprise $(
eg g\lor c_1\lor\cdots\lor c_k)$ and, for each child $c_i$, the clause $(g\lor
eg c_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: a list of child circuits on $n$ variables
